QuestInfo.0: Another hour, another mission. Talk to #bAntuin#k.
QuestInfo.1: You've delivered the item requested by the boss, so return to #bGen's Hideout#k.
QuestInfo.2: You returned to the hideout after delivering the item requested by the boss.

0.msg: And what brings the great hero to this humble place? Here to help us again?\r\n

1.msg: Cram it! Just 'cause I'm not completely shameless, that doesn't make me some dumb hero.\r\n

2.msg: ...I'm thankful that you saved us. When I'm feeling better, teach me how to use a chain like you!\r\n

3.msg: You got a long way to go before you're ready for that... lackey. Anyway, I didn't save you for free. You have to pay me back, plus interest.\r\n

4.msg: Old man, I got a delivery for you. Take it so I can get out of here.\r\n

5.msg: Ah, I see. Thank you. I didn't mean to hold you up a busy person such as you...\r\n
